decisions.reason: After four years of disappointing results and given its low centrality and limited public commitment, the firm no longer attributes weak sales to temporary causes and drops it to free resources.
As a core, prominently featured box car trailer series with high sunk costs and strong public commitment, the firm continues to keep it despite any disappointments.
The car transporter line is central to professional customers and has received substantial investment, so escalation pressures strongly favor continued support.
The low-bed series remains highly visible and aligned with the firm's quality focus, so the firm persists to justify its investment.
The high trailer cover series benefits from home-page visibility and complements the portfolio, leading to continued commitment.
Despite possible overlap with Product B, the firm's public commitment and investment in this box car series still make dropping it unlikely, though the probability is somewhat higher.
